text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, everyone's here? Good work at the fishing tournament yesterday.
So, today——

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wait, what's wrong? You've got that "I was draining the water from my cup yakisoba and spilled the whole thing!" face on.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......Umm. Actually——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I got a call from the President...
She invited me to a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: But it was scheduled for today... so, I politely turned it down, but——

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......I... found myself thinking that, if it meant I could run with the President and the others, I'd want to prioritize that......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......"To reach the destination called victory, resting is also important. In other words, rest isn't standing still — it's a necessary step——"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's what I learned from Bright-san.
But that was... just me thinking I'd learned it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I already had plans with everyone.
And I......

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Hmmmm. You're a real piece of work, huh.
Like I figured, you're just way too serious......

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Too serious......?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......There, there.
Shall we go play, then☆

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Come, come! The Find the Best Napping Spot Championship is reaching its climax!
Who, I wonder, will take the crown?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here, here! Sky-senpai! How about over there?
Looks like you could totally nap there, right? We just gotta put down a big cushion!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna put down a big cushion, you can nap anywhere.
That's not it, Pandora! The ideal napping spot, you see——

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Good sunlight. A tree root or something for a pillow. The teacher can't find you. Easy to get to. There's a roof. It has to be somewhere the teacher won't find you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Aren't you asking for a lot?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(............It's Sky-san, so there must be a point to it, right??
Even this childish, um... seemingly pointless play)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (......But if we're going to play, something more meaningful would... No — maybe this very "pointlessness" is the point. In her own way.)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a cat. A tabby. ......It's got a real insolent face on it, huh.
Nice, I like it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. It's a kitty.
Meow meow♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's got a collar, so maybe someone's pet? Its fur is so sleek and shiny...
You must be well-loved, aren't you? Scritchy-scratch.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (......Fufu, how cute. Just watching it somehow soothes me... ——soothes? ......Healing!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(I see. Maybe Sky-san is teaching me that rest ought to have "healing" in it?
That, too, is one of the nourishments you need for racing——)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Idea☆ Ai-chan, Ai-chan! Get the kitty in too and let's take a pic together! Okay, love and peace♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ohh... peace?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey. Over there.
What does that cloud look like to you?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eh, that cloud? Let me see... hmmmm... ha!
"A hero, in the very moment of drawing his sword," wouldn't you say?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ehh? That's awfully specific... huh? But now that you mention it, it kind of does look like that... ohh, as expected of Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then! That cloud over there... a furlong pole!
Doesn't it look like a furlong pole?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ahh... sure, I guess?
I can kind of see it, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (W-wait? Maybe this isn't it. To heal yourself, is the point that chatting about nothing with friends matters too......?)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (Ah, because it was a furlong pole?! Maybe the lesson is that I should forget about racing and just look at the clouds... is that what she means, maybe......?)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Pheww............
Nice weather.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ......Sky-san! Please let me confirm something!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Confirm what?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Your intent behind the rest you gave us! I...
thought about it... the meaning of every single bit of play we did with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
This time is like a detox, healing body and mind for the next race——
which is exactly why you're deliberately doing things that have nothing to do with racing, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: There's no meaning or anything, really.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Eh.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: There's no meaning!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Aahh?! I-I'm sorry! I dropped the polite speech...
Eh... but, eh...!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ You're overreacting just a bit, aren't you.
You've actually got a cute side, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: P-please don't tease me...! I mean, if that's the case... then why am I......

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
......Fufu. But still, Ai.
It might be pointless——but.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Isn't it fine to have time like this?
